title: A word frequency counter
description:
Count words with a `HashMap`.

```
the: 4
cat: 2
sat: 2
mat: 1
```
hints: `text.to_lowercase().split(|c: char| !c.is_alphabetic()).filter(|w| !w.is_empty())` gives the words (lesson 3.02): `c.is_alphabetic()` is true when the `char` is a letter, and `split` cuts wherever the closure returns true.
Collect into a `Vec<(&String, &usize)>` and `sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(a.1).then(a.0.cmp(b.0)))`.
requirements: Lower-case the text and split on anything that is not a letter.
Print sorted by count (highest first), then alphabetically.
stretch: Print only the top `n`, with `n` read from the user.
